newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria May industrial sales fall 8.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria May industrial sales fall 8.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgaria's receipts from industrial sales fell a real eight percent year on year in May to 1.25 trillion levs at current prices, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said on Thursday.
Receipts from sales of both the state and private sectors totalled 5.065 trillion levs for the first five months of this year, down a real 15 percent from the same period of 1996.

Sales of the state industrial sector alone totalled 970 billion levs in May, a real 11 percent less than in the same month of 1996 while sales of the private sector were up a real one percent to 280 billion levs at current prices.

State industrial sales for the first five months stood at 4.093 trillion levs, down a real 18 percent from the same period of last year as sales of the private sector fell a real four percent to 972 billion levs at current prices, the NSI said.

State industrial sector domestic sales fell a real 26 percent year-on-year in May and shrank by 29 percent year-on-year in the first five months due to soaring inflation and declining number of orders.

State sector exports rose a real 15 percent year-on-year in May and gained by a real five percent from January through May compared to the same period of 1996. The NSI did not provide figures for the nominal volume of sales.
NSI officials declined to elaborate on the reasons for the rise in exports of the state industrial sector.

Monthly consumer price inflation for May was 5.6 percent and inflation for the first five months was 479.4 percent. Year on year inflation for May was 1,840.2 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
